subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/tev:HSD_ChanGetAllocData

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/tev:HSD_Channel2Num

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/tev:HSD_Index2TevStage

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/tev:HSD_RenderGetAllocData

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/tev:HSD_RenderInitAllocData
subjects.behavior: Initializes and registers the HSD fixed-size object pools used for render records, TEV-register records, and channel records as part of the baselib-wide object-allocation initialization sequence.
subjects.naming_decision: Retain canonical names; no redundant aliases. Parameter r-labels are catalog ordinals, not physical register assertions.

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/tev:HSD_SetTevRegAll
subjects.behavior: Flushes all marked entries in HSD's four-slot signed TEV color-register state to the corresponding GX TEV registers as part of finalizing render-mode setup.
subjects.naming_decision: Retain canonical names; no redundant aliases. Parameter r-labels are catalog ordinals, not physical register assertions.

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/tev:HSD_SetupChannel
subjects.behavior: Programs register-sourced channel colors and lighting controls according to per-component cached comparisons and invalidation flags. Combined color/alpha control requests compare only the RGB-side control cache, so this routine does not guarantee restoration of a separately diverged alpha configuration.
subjects.naming_decision: Retain canonical names; no redundant aliases. Parameter r-labels are catalog ordinals, not physical register assertions.

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/tev:HSD_SetupChannelAll
subjects.behavior: Installs an entire linked set of HSD color-channel descriptors for subsequent rendering and selects the zero-, one-, or two-channel GX configuration required by the highest channel referenced by that set.
subjects.naming_decision: Retain canonical names; no redundant aliases. Parameter r-labels are catalog ordinals, not physical register assertions.

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/tev:HSD_SetupTevStage
subjects.behavior: Programs one GameCube GX texture-environment stage from an HSD_TevDesc, installing both the stage's texture/raster input routing and either a predefined TEV mode or a fully specified color-and-alpha combiner configuration.
subjects.naming_decision: Retain canonical names; no redundant aliases. Parameter r-labels are catalog ordinals, not physical register assertions.

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/tev:HSD_SetupTevStageAll
subjects.behavior: Configures an entire linked list of HSD TEV-stage descriptions and installs the GX stage count needed to cover the greatest stage referenced by that list.
subjects.naming_decision: Retain canonical names; no redundant aliases. Parameter r-labels are catalog ordinals, not physical register assertions.

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/tev:HSD_StateAssignTev
subjects.behavior: Reserves the next sequential TEV stage in the current HSD render-state batch and returns its GX TEV-stage identifier.
subjects.naming_decision: Retain canonical names; no redundant aliases. Parameter r-labels are catalog ordinals, not physical register assertions.

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/tev:HSD_StateGetNumTevStages
subjects.behavior: Reports how many TEV stages have been accumulated for the render state currently being assembled, allowing render-mode finalization to detect an empty TEV pipeline and install a pass-through color stage before committing the stage count to GX.
subjects.naming_decision: Retain canonical names; no redundant aliases. Parameter r-labels are catalog ordinals, not physical register assertions.

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/tev:HSD_StateInitTev
subjects.behavior: Starts a fresh TEV-stage allocation pass by resetting HSD's current TEV-stage cursor before a material or specialized render path constructs and installs its TEV configuration.
subjects.naming_decision: Retain canonical names; no redundant aliases. Parameter r-labels are catalog ordinals, not physical register assertions.

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/tev:HSD_StateRegisterTexGen
subjects.behavior: Registers a texture-coordinate generator as required by the current render setup, increasing the pending GX texture-generator count when the supplied coordinate lies beyond all coordinates registered so far.
subjects.naming_decision: Retain canonical names; no redundant aliases. Parameter r-labels are catalog ordinals, not physical register assertions.

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/tev:HSD_StateSetNumChans
subjects.behavior: Conditionally installs the requested GX fixed-function lighting/color-channel count, avoiding the GX state-setting call when the request equals HSD's retained previous-channel-count value.
subjects.naming_decision: Retain canonical names; no redundant aliases. Parameter r-labels are catalog ordinals, not physical register assertions.

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/tev:HSD_StateSetNumTevStages
subjects.behavior: Finalizes the current TEV-stage allocation pass by installing the number of stages assigned through HSD's TEV state allocator into GX, then prepares the allocator for a new pass.
subjects.naming_decision: Retain canonical names; no redundant aliases. Parameter r-labels are catalog ordinals, not physical register assertions.

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/tev:HSD_StateSetNumTexGens
subjects.behavior: Finalizes the texture-coordinate-generator requirement accumulated for the current render-state setup by installing that count in GX and reopening the accumulator for the next setup.
subjects.naming_decision: Retain canonical names; no redundant aliases. Parameter r-labels are catalog ordinals, not physical register assertions.

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/tev:HSD_TevRegGetAllocData
subjects.behavior: Provides access to the unit-owned allocation descriptor for HSD TEV-register objects, whose pool is configured for 20-byte objects with 4-byte alignment.
subjects.naming_decision: Retain canonical names; no redundant aliases. Parameter r-labels are catalog ordinals, not physical register assertions.

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/tev:HSD_TevStage2Index
subjects.behavior: Provides a checked conversion from an HSD/GX TEV-stage selector to its zero-based TEV-stage slot index.
subjects.naming_decision: Retain canonical names; no redundant aliases. Parameter r-labels are catalog ordinals, not physical register assertions.

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/tev:HSD_TevStage2Num
subjects.behavior: Converts a zero-based GX TEV stage identifier into the number of stages required to include that stage, allowing list-wide TEV setup to derive the hardware stage count from the highest stage encountered.
subjects.naming_decision: Retain canonical names; no redundant aliases. Parameter r-labels are catalog ordinals, not physical register assertions.

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/tev:HSD_TexCoordID2Num
subjects.behavior: Converts a texture-coordinate identifier into the number of texture generators required to make that coordinate available: identifiers 0 through 7 become counts 1 through 8, the null identifier 0xFF requires zero generators, and any other identifier triggers an assertion.
subjects.naming_decision: Retain canonical names; no redundant aliases. Parameter r-labels are catalog ordinals, not physical register assertions.

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/tev:_HSD_StateInvalidateColorChannel
subjects.behavior: Invalidates HSD's cached GX color-channel state so subsequent channel setup cannot suppress the GX writes needed to re-establish ambient colors, material colors, lighting controls, and the active channel count.
subjects.naming_decision: Retain canonical names; no redundant aliases. Parameter r-labels are catalog ordinals, not physical register assertions.

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/tev:_HSD_StateInvalidateTevRegister
subjects.behavior: Clears the pending-state markers for all four software TEV color-register slots so the subsequent TEV-register flush does not submit stale slot values to GX.
subjects.naming_decision: Retain canonical names; no redundant aliases. Parameter r-labels are catalog ordinals, not physical register assertions.

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/tev:_HSD_StateInvalidateTevStage
subjects.behavior: Invalidates HSD's pending TEV-stage allocation state by discarding the accumulated stage count, causing the next staged TEV setup pass to allocate again from the first GX TEV stage.
subjects.naming_decision: Retain canonical names; no redundant aliases. Parameter r-labels are catalog ordinals, not physical register assertions.

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/tev:_HSD_StateInvalidateTexCoordGen
subjects.behavior: Discards the texture-coordinate-generator count accumulated by HSD's render-state registration pass so subsequent registration begins with no pending generator requirement, without immediately programming GX hardware.
subjects.naming_decision: Retain canonical names; no redundant aliases. Parameter r-labels are catalog ordinals, not physical register assertions.
